name: Issachar (gatekeeper)
title: Levitical temple guard
summary: Issachar was one of the Levitical gatekeepers from the family of Obed-Edom who served at the house of the Lord during David's time.

keyEvents.title: Gatekeeper at the temple
keyEvents.description: Issachar is listed among the sons of Obed-Edom who served as gatekeepers.
